verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-export or bulk-download feature, and names no open export formats such as CSV, JSON or Parquet. The OTel endpoint only imports traces. The Service API's REST endpoints, including /calls/stream_query, are developer building blocks a user could script an export with, not a documented export capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
